pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Fall damage is rejected. Keep the flying target in view and leave room to move sideways; retreat from the area of its side attack. Reaching the floor does not

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: mean that the enemy loses health.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Bottle Of Annihilation. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
